_doc: 06 §3.1-3.6 and §5, 18 — a STARTER subset of the 82-row 06 §3 catalogue (06 §3's own rows; the other 8 of the 12 Dice & Board rows live in 04 §5, out of this file's scope), drawn to exercise every 18 DSL construct the starter tier can honestly reach at least twice and every 06 §4 / 24 §4.7 draft composition rule at least once, per M3-07's task charter. Cursed Perks (06 §3.7) are excluded entirely — they carry a Benefit/Cost shape, not tiers, and arrive with the curse system (M3-03/M3-11). Every row NOT authored here is registered in .claude/handovers/M3-07-unauthored-perks-register.json as M3-07b's input, checkable against this file in both directions by PerkCatalogueRegisterTests. Zero per-perk code: every effect below is DSL data validated against schema/effect.schema.json by DeclaredRules' R35.

perks.name: Sharp Edge
perks.description: +{value}% ATK.

perks.name: Brutality
perks.description: +{value}% damage to enemies above 70% health.

perks.name: Executioner
perks.description: +{value}% damage to enemies below the HP threshold (30% at Tier I-II, 35% at Tier III).

perks.name: Flurry
perks.description: Every {everyNth}th attack hits twice.

perks.name: Rupture
perks.description: Attacks apply Bleed ({value}% ATK/s for {duration}s).

perks.name: Giant Slayer
perks.description: +{value}% damage to Elites and Bosses.

perks.name: Cleave
perks.description: Attacks hit all enemies for {value}% damage.

perks.name: Sundering Blows
perks.description: Attacks apply Sunder (-{value}% DEF, stacks 5) to the toughest enemy standing.

perks.name: Deathmark
perks.description: Every {interval}s, mark an enemy: it takes +{value}% damage and is prioritised.

perks.name: Apex Predator
perks.description: Crits reduce all cooldowns by {value}s and refresh Rage.

perks.name: Chain of Ruin
perks.description: Killing an enemy deals {value}% of its Max HP to all others.

perks.name: Berserker's Pact
perks.description: +{value}% ATK per 1% missing HP, up to +{cap}%.

perks.name: Thornmail
perks.description: Reflect {value}% of damage taken.

perks.name: Warded
perks.description: Start each battle with a shield equal to {value}% Max HP.

perks.name: Evasive Step
perks.description: Dodging grants +{value}% Attack Speed for 2s.

perks.name: Stalwart
perks.description: -{value}% damage taken from Elites and Bosses (PvE only).

perks.name: Immovable
perks.description: Immune to Stun and Freeze.

perks.name: Last Stand
perks.description: Below 25% HP: +{value}% DEF and +{value2}% Damage Reduction.

perks.name: Mirror Ward
perks.description: Reflect {value}% of damage taken; +{value2}% Max HP.

perks.name: Unbreakable
perks.description: Once per battle, survive a lethal hit at 1 HP and gain a shield equal to {value}% Max HP.

perks.name: Living Fortress
perks.description: x1.{value} multiplicative Max HP and DEF; -{value2}% Attack Speed.

perks.name: Slow Regeneration
perks.description: Heal {value}% Max HP/s in battle.

perks.name: Vital Surge
perks.description: Heal {value}% Max HP after each battle won.

perks.name: Sanguine Pact
perks.description: Crits heal for {value}% of damage dealt.

perks.name: Undying Will
perks.description: At 0 HP, revive once per battle at {value}% HP.

perks.name: Transfusion
perks.description: Overheal converts into a shield, up to {sourceCapPct}% Max HP.

perks.name: Phoenix Heart
perks.description: Reviving (any source) also grants Rage: +{value}% ATK for {duration}s.

perks.name: Eternal Spring
perks.description: Heal {value}% Max HP/s; healing also damages the lowest-HP enemy for the same amount.

perks.name: Pathfinder
perks.description: See the contents of the next {value} tiles instead of 6.

perks.name: Scout's Instinct
perks.description: Fork previews reveal exact tile contents.

perks.name: Leapfrog
perks.description: Landing on an empty tile grants {value} free extra roll(s).

perks.name: Cartographer
perks.description: Once per stage, choose any tile in the next 6 and move there.

perks.name: Greed
perks.description: +{value}% Gold from all sources.

perks.name: Merchant's Friend
perks.description: Shops show {value} slots instead of 4.

perks.name: Alchemy
perks.description: Convert Gold to Crowns at run end (10:1, max {cap} Crowns).

perks.name: Dragon's Hoard
perks.description: +{value}% ATK per 100 Gold currently held.

perks.name: Turtle Doctrine
perks.description: Convert {value}% of DEF into ATK.

perks.name: Duelist
perks.description: +{value}% damage when exactly one enemy remains.

perks.name: Swarmbane
perks.description: +{value}% damage when 3 or more enemies are present.

perks.name: Opening Gambit
perks.description: First attack of each battle deals x{value} damage.

perks.name: Pack Leader
perks.description: +{value}% pet damage; pets gain a share of your Crit Chance.

perks.name: Arsenal
perks.description: +{value}% all stats per distinct perk category you own.

perks.name: Gambler's Ruin
perks.description: 50% chance each attack deals x{high}, 50% chance x{low}.

perks.name: Perfectionist
perks.description: +{value}% all stats while at 100% HP.

perks.name: Avatar of the Die
perks.description: Your current die face count of Star/Surge/Fortune x +{value}% all stats, each.

perks.name: Snowball
perks.description: +{value}% permanent ATK per battle won this run (no cap).
